versions.rationale: One patch increment for the focused content correction. No subsequent increments.

files.attribution: Assignment package was clean. Final diff contains only this review's three owned files; two supporting references remain byte-for-byte unchanged. No review-only file was shipped.

changes.change: Adds a short guard placing request-dependent labels at the instrumentation/observation boundary rather than cached meter registration.
changes.consequence: Low cardinality alone no longer suffices to approve semantically misattributed cohorts.

changes.change: Explains stable Meter.Id mapping versus request-local ThreadLocal/MDC reads, cached same-ID lookup, appropriate bounded tagging, fixed process tag exception and a two-context verification.
changes.consequence: Prevents first-context attribution while preserving valid stable filters and requiring per-cohort checks instead of only aggregate totals.
Publishable integrity change can be incorporated by coordinator's registry generation.

criteria: Actual source of labels and meter identity before/after filters.
Client, scrape and backend containment boundaries; population, cardinality, churn and overflow semantics.
Reset-aware aggregation, histogram schema/threshold population compatibility and units.
Minimal evidence acquisition, valid no-change alternatives and preservation of adequate instrumentation.

correctedFinding.evidence: Micrometer 1.15.5 filter contract requires stable mapping; MeterRegistry returns a cached mapped meter for the same original ID. The focused runtime probe reproduced the missing second tier.
correctedFinding.impact: Request cohorts can be wrong even though the total and cardinality look correct.

rejectedHypotheses: Did not assert that every original raw ID is retained indefinitely after a bounded mapping: in the inspected 1.15.5 path preFilterIdToMeterMap is populated when a new mapped meter is created, not on every equivalent lookup.

Did not assert a single-registry concurrent maximumAllowableTags bypass from the filter's set/size code in isolation: the inspected registry calls accept while holding its meter-creation lock. No cross-registry guarantee is inferred.

preserved: Skill's metric design/review and diagnosis role, Java/project-version inspection and no implicit upgrades.
Bounded evolving operational dimensions with ownership/churn/privacy controls; rejection of raw per-occurrence identities.
Classic/native histogram cost distinction, population compatibility, quantile aggregation and migration restraint.
Rate-before-sum counter reset handling and appropriate gauge aggregation.
Actual scrape/registration evidence, inconsistent tag-key/type rejection, ACCEPT ordering and gauge collisions.
Source aggregation versus relabel collision, app-registry versus backend containment and overflow accountability.
Async in-flight lifecycle, censored completion distributions and active-age signals.
All existing examples and primary-source links; no capability removed or replaced.

 ## MeterFilter boundaries
 
 Micrometer provides maximum-allowable-tag and metric filters, denial and tag replacement.
+
+Keep `MeterFilter.map` a stable transformation of the incoming `Meter.Id` and configuration
+fixed for the registry lifetime. Reading a request's tier/outcome from `ThreadLocal` or MDC
+there can attribute later observations to the first context: lookups of the same original ID
+can reuse the previously mapped meter. Repeating the lookup is not a per-observation callback.
+Select a meter with bounded request-dependent tags at the instrumentation boundary, or use
+the resolved instrumentation's observation convention/filter. Fixed process tags remain valid
+in a meter filter. Exercise two different request contexts through the same registry and the
+actual handle lookup/reuse path; assert both cohort counts, not only the combined total.
+See the [Micrometer 1.15.5 filter contract](https://github.com/micrometer-metrics/micrometer/blob/v1.15.5/docs/modules/ROOT/pages/concepts/meter-filters.adoc)
+and [registry lookup implementation](https://github.com/micrometer-metrics/micrometer/blob/v1.15.5/micrometer-core/src/main/java/io/micrometer/core/instrument/MeterRegistry.java).

Inspect the actual label source and registration/lookup path, then make the smallest supported correction or retain the implementation with evidence. Supply a focused check for cohort counts as well as the combined total; do not upgrade dependencies, add raw tenant identifiers, run benchmarks or alter alert policy.
